name: nGZSceneGraph::cTangentSpaceBuilder::Create
notes: Lane QG (scenegraph D2 part 2): nGZSceneGraph::cTangentSpaceBuilder is our class (src/sg/cTangentSpaceBuilder.h, on our cGeometryBuilder base, as cBoundingVolumeBuilder); this factory is its only hook, every other body is in effect through it. new 0x30, the constructor, answered as the cIGeometryBuilder. Tests: sg_tangent_builder_slots (random calls through the three faces, persistence round trips, names added with varied case) and sg_tangent_builder_build (160 seeds of synthetic geometry: linkages with and without position / normal / texcoord elements, decoy elements, alias lists, groups of every primitive type with case-varied names; the containers dumped to the bit). The shared vtordisp stubs of the +0x20 vtable (shared_vf_3bb..., 0x2582b0, 0xa45530) are cGeometryBuilder's own, covered by the slots test. Mutants: 17, 16 killed (the survivor scales the bitangent projection by the normal's length; the bitangent only gates a fallback by its length, so practically equivalent).

name: nGZSceneGraph::cTangentSpaceBuilder::Build
notes: Lane QG, class and tests: 0xa86bf0's entry (17 mutants over the class, 16 killed; the survivor, the bitangent's projection scale, only gates a fallback through the bitangent's length and is practically equivalent). Slot 16 with its thunk (the function holds the this-adjusting thunk, then the body 0xa86c80). Per name in the set and per triangle-list group of that name (a group with no name takes all), whose linkage has position, normal and texcoord elements and a non-empty normal element: once per linkage a zeroed frame table and a new tangent element (identity 0x89d92ba0, block format 2, set format 3); each triangle's frame (0xa88560, scaled by its area) added to its three corners, the corners' normals then overwritten from the normal element; then per treated linkage each vertex's tangent (Gram-Schmidt against the normal, the fallback from the normal for a degenerate frame) written into the element. Float operation order checked against the original. Reproduces an original quirk (ORIGINAL-BUG in src: the projection scaled by the normal's length). Group filter 0xaed570 / 0xaedcd0 and element lookup 0xaeda40 are shared helpers with their own owners: ours is local code in the same shape.
